# Roboto clock glyphs

The clock glyph subset in `main/font_clock.c` is generated from the Google Fonts Roboto Variable font with the `Bold` variation at 12px.

- Source repository: <https://github.com/google/fonts>
- Source path: `ofl/roboto/Roboto[wdth,wght].ttf`
- Source commit: `6183fc0d26361f6ddfd6f6b7a736e1467c6d8a43`
- Source file SHA256: `d7598e12c5dbef095ff8272cfc55da0250bd07fbdecbac8a530b9b277872a134`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see [`OFL.txt`](OFL.txt)

The font file is only a generation input and is kept in the ignored `.cache/fonts/` directory. The generated 1bpp C subset is what the firmware links.
